environment.description: Go Gin application deployed as a Kubernetes Deployment in namespace 'web-apps'. Pod runs as root (UID 0) with privileged security context. No PodSecurityPolicy or Pod Security Standards enforced. Container uses hostPath volume mount at /var/run/secrets to access node-level service account tokens. Kubernetes RBAC grants the service account 'web-app-sa' full read/write to secrets in the namespace. No network policy restricts egress. Session cookies stored with SameSite=None and no Secure flag enforcement at the ingress layer.
